response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM telescope_counts) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - average_share AS share_difference FROM shares ORDER BY share_difference DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;
